name: power_climate_query
description: Fetch NASA POWER daily climate data for a Bangladesh district. Returns T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX, RH2M, PRECTOTCORR, WS50M_MAX as daily time series. dataset_id: NASA_POWER_AG_DAILY. source_url: https://power.larc.nasa.gov. Note: MERRA-2 reanalysis, not station observations. Resolution: 0.5°x0.625°.

lat.description: Latitude of the district centroid (e.g. 24.37 for Rajshahi)

lon.description: Longitude of the district centroid (e.g. 88.60 for Rajshahi)

name: winter_cold_day_trend
description: Story 1 (Winter Vacationer): Count cold days (T2M_MIN <= 14°C) in Dec20-Jan5 window for each year, then run Modified Mann-Kendall trend test. Returns verdict REAL_TREND | WEAK_SIGNAL | NOISE with full provenance JSON for cite_check.

name: monsoon_onset_trend
description: Story 2 (Rain-Lover): Compute monsoon onset day-of-year for each year using GPM IMERG Final V07, then test for delay trend using Modified Mann-Kendall. Returns slope in days/decade. dataset_id: GPM_3IMERGDF_07.

name: district_climate_rank
description: Story 3 (Retirement Relocator): Rank Bangladesh districts by heat index trend slope. Returns sorted DataFrame with district, trend direction, slope per decade, and p-value. Green = improving, Red = worsening.

name: dhaka_lst_nightlight_correlation
description: Story 4 (Urban Planner): Compute spatial correlation between MODIS MOD11A2 LST warming trend and VIIRS Day/Night Band brightening trend across Dhaka. Returns Spearman r_value, p_value, and hot-spot pixel count.

name: coastal_extreme_trend
description: Story 5 (Coastal Defender): Count extreme weather days (P95 rain events, high wind) per year for coastal Bangladesh districts and test for trend. Returns frequency trend and intensity trend separately. dataset_id: NASA_POWER_AG_DAILY.

district.description: Coastal district (Bhola, Barisal, Cox's Bazar, Khulna)

name: cite_check
description: Validate that every numeric claim in the agent's output maps to a dataset_id and source_url. Returns true only if ALL claims pass. MUST be called before any output is shown to the user. Blocks output and shows Citation Required warning on failure.

text.description: The exact claim text containing the number

source_url.description: NASA endpoint URL the number came from
